# Set Bluetooth

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Sets the devices bluetooth to the given boolean.

## Syntax

~~~~text
setBluetooth(value: <#BoolNumb#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
setBluetooth(value: true)
~~~~
